quarterly_data.signal: Updated risk factors describe Supermicro's related-party supply chain: Ablecom provides contract design and manufacturing coordination support and warehousing, and its affiliate Compuware provides distribution, contract manufacturing and warehousing, with Supermicro outsourcing to Compuware a portion of its design activities and a significant part of its manufacturing of subassemblies, particularly power supplies. Purchases of products from Ablecom and Compuware represented 3.3%, 4.3% and 6.6% of cost of sales in fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023. Both are privately held Taiwan-based companies developing campuses near Supermicro's Malaysia campus to expand manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: Ablecom and Compuware purchases 3.3% of fiscal 2025 cost of sales (4.3% fiscal 2024, 6.6% fiscal 2023)
